summary: Comprehensive E2E validation of Sevora Pulse module complete. Backend: 23/23 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All Pulse pages load correctly with full functionality. Features tested: Post CRUD, Comments, Reactions, Recognition/Kudos, Work Updates with linking, Create Task from Post/Blocker, Leadership Dashboard, Department Wall, Auto-generated posts from integrated modules.

issues: WebSocket status shows 'Offline' in preview environment - this is expected as WS may not be configured for preview domain

critical_code_review_comments: All Pulse backend APIs return proper data structures with correct HTTP status codes
Create Task from Post correctly creates tasks with 'from-pulse' label and links back to source post
Create Task from Blocker correctly creates tasks with 'blocker' label and high priority
Leadership Dashboard shows comprehensive stats: Total Posts, Posts Today, This Week, Recognitions, Achievements, Issues, Department Activity, Top Contributors
Recognition Wall shows badge types with employee search and selection
Department Wall shows department-specific posts with filter capability
Auto-generated posts from integrated modules visible (Brand Mention Spike, New Influencer Partnership, Project Completed, Deal Closed)
Work Updates form has Link buttons for all fields: Completed, Blockers, Tomorrow's Focus
Pulse Feed shows reaction buttons (👍 🎉 ❤️ 💡), comment counts, and post type badges
seed_data_creation: Test posts, comments, reactions, recognitions, daily/weekly updates created via API tests (prefixed with TEST_)
